## Conquerors of Smart India Hackathon 2022

News Date : 13 Sep 2022News ReportIn the Smart India Hackathon 2022 software edition organized at Warangal, Telangana on 25th and 26th August 2022, Mahatma Gandhi institute of technology Team has baggedFirst Prize of 1 Lakh, for the Problem Statement offline Portal Direct Benefit Transfer of Scholarship and other government qualifications.Principal and Management of MGIT , Gandipet, Hyderabad, have congratulated the team members CHINTHA MANISH KUMAR(CSE),SAGAR LALWANI(ECE),PAREPALLI VENKAT CHARAN(CSD) ,MOHAMMED MUBASHIRUDDIN(CSD),GOLI PRERANA(CSD),EGA PUJITHA(CSE) and Team Mentors :K BAPAYYA(ECE),Y PAVAN NARSIMHA RAO (CSE).
